title: upload basal rate to Tidepool
symptom: Basal rate information is not uploaded to Tidepool from xDrip, even though other data syncs correctly. Users report that basal injections appear as bolus injections in Tidepool, and some users do not see basal rates at all.
cause: The issue was initially thought to be on the Tidepool side, as Tidepool had not yet supported basal uploads in Blip. Later, it was implemented/activated in xDrip with commit 5058163 and released with version 2022.04.30.
fix: Update xDrip to version 2022.04.30 or later, which includes the implementation/activation of basal rate upload to Tidepool.
evidence_quote: This was implemented/activated with 5058163 and released with [2022.04.30](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2022.04.30).
